text_block_list.name: Excited Spectator
text_block_list.text: "Hey! Who do you think is gonna win this Derby!?"

text_block_list.name: TV-Loving Spectator
text_block_list.text:
"It's gotta be one of the Big Three, right?
I mean, they even said so on TV!"

text_block_list.name: Excited Spectator
text_block_list.text:
"Then I'm castin' my vote for that young lady!
I mean, she's the daughter of a legendary Umamusume, ain't she?"

text_block_list.name: TV-Loving Spectator
text_block_list.text:
Ehh, well then I want Special Week to win!
I mean, in that special feature the other day—

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: ...It's finally here. The Derby.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
H-Huh!? T-There's no way that's true!
King is j-j-just... fine, as always!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
I've got plenty of room to spare!
You'll be watching me in the Satsuki Sho, right?

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
There is nothing to worry about!
I will win today, and that is all there is to it!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
"Even if it's the Derby race!
No, precisely *because* this is the Derby...!"

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: I will definitely win my race and...

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
...I swear, Mother,
I will make you acknowledge me...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: —And then, five minutes later.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
"...Lying just up ahead before my eyes...
are carrots. A whole field full of carrots."

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
"It's alright, I'm okay.
There's nothing to worry about—"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Wooooaaaah----!)

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Geez! So noisy...
And just when the King is about to make her entrance...

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
? ...Wait. Then who is it
basking in those massive cheers right now...?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Wah...! Thank you so much for your support!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
I absolutely will not lose this race!
I'll turn everyone's cheers into strength and run!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
If I win this Derby, I want to...
...I want to make everyone proud!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
For the sake of the mom who raised me,
and for the sake of the mom who gave birth to me...!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: I want to become the number one horse girl in Japan!
